## RE:volution Mod v2.8.0

### Added

- A functional five-track God Worship System with independent unlock, level, charge, buff and cooldown state.
- God-specific resource routing and Balance Core curves for unlock/upgrade costs, charge requirements, buff strength, durations and cooldown behavior.
- An isolated late God damage layer with primary channels for Poison, Decay, All Damage, Wither and Bleeding, plus gated secondary-channel foundations.
- Persistent Offerings generated only across factual active-buff intervals, including mathematical offline settlement without relog duplication.
- Auto Worship for charge/cooldown assistance and activation modes `MANUAL`, `AUTO_WHEN_READY` and `LINKED_TO_GOD`.
- Bounded linked activation with multi-link support, self-link rejection, safe cyclic configurations and not-ready linked-God skipping.
- A permanent all-God buff-duration meta-upgrade paid with Offerings; upgrades affect future activations only.
- Feature gates for Auto Activation, permanent duration upgrades, secondary buffs and Mastery Reset preservation.
- Backward-compatible Mongo persistence separating run-scoped God progression from persistent Offerings/meta/preferences.
- Factual God gameplay events integrated into the generic v2.7 event layer for Quests and future systems.
- Server-authoritative God network requests with monotonic replay protection and Worship-click rate limiting.
- Functional God Worship UI with five God rows, charge/state/timers, costs, automation settings, activation links, Offerings and duration controls.
- A future God-effectiveness extension point for later Pet/season systems without adding new Pet content in v2.8.0.

### Fixed / Guaranteed

- Cooldown begins at factual buff expiry and continues through offline time using absolute timestamps.
- Passive charge exists only while the God Worship panel is open and never accumulates offline.
- Without Auto Activation, automation cannot perform the final manual charge step or activate a God by itself.
- Offerings settlement is capped at the factual `buffActiveUntil` boundary and is idempotent across reconnect/restart processing.
- Permanent duration purchases do not retroactively modify an already-active buff snapshot.
- Disabled God tracks are inert for mutations, passive charge, Offerings generation and automated activation while existing timers still normalize safely.
- Default Mastery Reset clears God run progression while preserving Offerings, permanent-duration meta and automation/activation preferences; the preservation gate can retain full God progression.
- Secondary channels use the same X as the God primary effect and same-channel God contributions stack additively inside the isolated God layer.

### Balance / Testing

- Added bundled `v2.8.0-god-worship.json` Balance Core overlay with canonical lowercase IDs and ZBT Draft numeric values.
- Regression coverage includes economy, lifecycle, offline settlement, menu-only passive charge, final-manual-step behavior, linked propagation, cycle safety, duration snapshots, reset preservation, secondary gates, effectiveness extension, factual events, migration and network guards.
- Release CI validates Java 8 clean build/tests, architecture/resource contracts, version consistency and packaged JAR contents.
